6 of 63 k8s roles are staging-gated (`STAGING_SUBSET` against every directory under `ansible/roles/k8s/`).

21 auto-deploy-eligible role(s) sit outside the gate — an image-pin bump to any of these reaches production unattended with no staging run first: `artifacts`, `bazarr`, `bento-pdf`, `configarr`, `docs`, `headlamp`, `home-assistant`, `homelab-mcp`, `homepage`, `jellyfin`, `littlelink`, `media-volume`, `n8n-images`, `netpol-baseline`, `peanut`, `pi-peer-backup`, `prowlarr`, `radarr`, `sonarr`, `speedtest`, `texbrain`.
